summary: Frontend-only verification of desktop nav refactor: left sidebar for project tools + header Menu dropdown for Home/Budget/Team/Media. All 6 review items verified green at 1440x900, 390x844 and 820x1180. BRRR correctly hidden for the seeded personal 'Home renovation' demo project. No regressions on mobile bottom tabs / quick-action grid.
critical_code_review_comments: quick-actions filter uses `!['ai','brrr','report','receipt','sold','epc'].includes(a.id)` so when money is hidden only `snags` and `inbox` remain in the sidebar/home grid — intentional per useCanSeeMoney, worth a quick sanity check for stakeholder/co-owner viewers.
DesktopHeader hides Budget tab via `visible = tabs.filter(t => state.routes.some(r => r.name === t.name))` which correctly piggybacks on the `href: null` in _layout.tsx when money is hidden. Good.
Minor: on desktop the primary CTA 'Add Expense' overlaps the right column slightly (ctaWide 280px absolute, bottom-right) at 1440x900 — not reported in request, cosmetic only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop breakpoint is wide>=1024 via useLayout(); verified via widths 1440 (desktop), 820 (tablet, mobile layout), 390 (mobile). Login tip from request works: POST /api/auth/login then localStorage.setItem('mba_auth_token', JSON.stringify(access_token)) and reload. Expo supervisor had restarted during run — once bundler is healthy (~15s), all desktop-sidebar/desktop-header testIDs appear on first paint.
